text:
sasha: Rolled nebula-v2-int8 to canary (streaming + kvcache on). Seeing ~0.8% failures where client JSON parsing chokes on tool-call output when streaming chunk boundaries cut inside arrays/objects.

omar: Roughly where in the pipeline do you think the stream is being cut? Tokenizer? prefix compaction?

sasha: Example from canary logs (note chunk boundaries):
```json
{"tool": "lookup", "args": [{"id": 123}], "result": [
  {"name": "foo"},
  {"name": "bar"},
  {"name": "baz"},
  {"name": "qux"}
  ...
```
The subsequent stream chunk contains the closing array bracket and trailing fields. Our client sometimes parses mid-array and throws. Non-streaming requests parse fine.

jen: Any telemetry showing whether failures correlate with large result arrays or specific tokens?

sasha: ci-bot snapshot: json_parse_failures=0.8% (baseline 0.02%), failing=452/56500 in 24h. Failures skew towards longer arrays and responses that include punctuation-heavy names.

matt: Candidate fixes: 1) sentinel-wrap tool output (e.g., <<<JSON>>>...<<<END>>>), 2) require clients to buffer until EOF sentinel, 3) runtime change to avoid prefix trimming during tool-output streaming, 4) add a short reemit final-chunk with a guaranteed sentinel token. Performance/cost tradeoffs vary.

omar: Let's A/B test: 10% sentinel-wrap, 10% runtime-opt-out, 10% streaming-off, rest baseline. Need experiment ticket + token-level traces for failures + p50/p95 latency.

sasha: Filed ML-8421 with plan: 48h A/B, start with sentinel-wrap (lowest perf risk), collect token traces & kvprefix snapshots for failing requests.

jen: I'll add a small replay harness that can inject recorded token streams into our parser to reproduce the mid-chunk EOF errors locally. Also capture exact token ids around failure.

matt: I'll put a small opt-out flag in streamer to skip prefix compaction for flagged tool-output messages. PR will be behind a rollout guard.

ci-bot: canary-metrics: json_parse_failures=0.8%, baseline=0.02%, failing_requests=452, total_requests=56500 (24h).

sasha: Keeping canary at 10% while A/B runs. Sync tomorrow after 24h of data. :thinking_face:
